# IoTProgrammers

> MERN portfolio and demo website for IoTProgrammers — landing pages, product demos, client reviews, WhatsApp booking, and admin-managed content.

IoTProgrammers builds high-converting MERN stack portfolio sites with admin dashboards, demo video cards, and WhatsApp lead capture.

## Pages

- [Home](https://iotprogrammers.com/): Hero banners, feature cards, product demos, pricing, and booking.
- [Landing](https://iotprogrammers.com/landing): Bangla landing page with intro video, demo cards, reviews, and gallery.
- [Reviews](https://iotprogrammers.com/reviews): Client testimonials and ratings.
- [Contact](https://iotprogrammers.com/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, address, and quick booking form.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://iotprogrammers.com/privacy-policy): Data and privacy practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://iotprogrammers.com/terms-of-service): Terms of use.
- [Cookie Policy](https://iotprogrammers.com/cookie-policy): Cookie usage.
- [Refund Policy](https://iotprogrammers.com/refund-policy): Refund terms.
